answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the timber queue naming the lagoon that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every alias costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the relic record publishes exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
